patches.expected_old: Newly recovered readable source; full parameter and diet completeness has not been audited. Provisional loadability 20/55, documentation 10/20; geographic and recency components retained. Bibliographic/spatial correction:  Later 2020 report chapter A model of the Okhotsk Sea with a focus on marine mammals by Natalia Chaikina documents earlier 2004 thesis model; report container, not original thesis. Downloaded PDF page24 footnote explicitly identifies the 2020 chapter as based on Chaikina2004 BSc thesis A trophic mass-balance model of the Sea of Okhotsk for the 1980s period,49p.
patches.proposed: Original 2004 thesis identity is preserved. The related 2020 chapter supplies 29-group basic parameters and full diet. Accepted diet contains historical normalization of 8 printed drift columns; no repair adopted. Accepted canonical/runtime load is verified under inherited settings, with GE WARN, TE FAIL and Egestion WARN. No source species inventory, group catch vector or observed pollock stage split was recovered. Existing numerical scores are retained.
